global_rules.spacing: Generous spacing between sections (py-24, py-32). Optical alignment for icons and text. Use the generous Tailwind spacing scale.
global_rules.borders_and_shadows: Rely on 1px solid borders (border-white/10) to define sections. Avoid heavy shadows; use deep ambient shadows for floating overlays only.
global_rules.animations: Subtle framer-motion reveals (fade up, stagger). No bouncy physics. Linear tracing beams or glow effects for active states/CTAs.
global_rules.accessibility: Strict adherence to 4.5:1 contrast for text. All interactive elements MUST have role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

headings.scale: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl for Hero; text-2xl to text-4xl for sections

layout_strategies.hero: Technical, direct, asymmetrical or tightly centered. Massive H1 with tight tracking. A glowing or glassmorphism code block window must act as the primary hero visual, displaying a SQL query joining Postgres and S3.
layout_strategies.features: MODE A: THE 'TETRIS' GRID (Bento box). Use 1px border-white/10, bg-zinc-900/40. Hover introduces bg-zinc-900/80 and a subtle border color shift.
layout_strategies.architecture: Grid layout exposing the skeleton ('Technical Look'). Use pure HTML/Tailwind with dashed borders (border-dashed) or SVG lines to represent data flow from isolated workers to S3.
layout_strategies.comparison_table: Brutalist/minimalist table. No vertical dividers, 1px horizontal dividers. The 'LakeBridge' column should have a subtle bg-white/5 highlight and bright white checkmarks.
layout_strategies.navigation: Crystal Glass Variant: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60, sticky top, z-50, 1px bottom border (border-white/10). Explicit hover states on links (hover:text-white).

components.buttons: Square or subtle rounding (rounded-md). Primary CTA: bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10.
components.code_blocks: Background darker than the page (#050505 or bg-black). Include Mac-style window controls in grayscale. Syntax highlighting should use muted tech tones (pale blue, pale green, white).
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), border color lightens to white/30.

image_urls.description: Abstract dark geometric maze texture. Use with 5-10% opacity as a fixed background layer to reduce digital flatness and give a premium feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are working with .js files (not .tsx). Do not use TypeScript syntax in the components.
Install required font families (Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts or standard CSS imports in index.css.
Install and use 'lucide-react' for all icons.
Do not use generic placeholder images for logos (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake); use text-based logos with strong typography or inline SVGs.
Construct the architecture diagram purely out of HTML/Tailwind borders, flex/grid layouts, and simple SVG arrows/lines. No heavy image assets.
Forms (like Waitlist) should use heavily customized Shadcn UI elements to match the dark brutalist theme (flat, 1px borders, rounded-md max).
Implement the hero code block using a standard <div> structure styled to look like an IDE window. Show a mock SQL query utilizing LakeBridge features (e.g., SELECT * FROM postgres_db JOIN s3_lake).
Apply data-testid to all interactive elements for robust testing.
No cheesy marketing graphics or gradients. Rely entirely on typography, spacing, 1px borders, and code blocks to build CTO-level credibility.
